tools.name: kisi_get_current_user
tools.description: The Kisi user the API key belongs to (id, name, email, organization). Good first call. GET /user.

tools.name: kisi_get_organization
tools.description: The current Kisi organization (name, domain, settings summary). GET /organization.

tools.name: kisi_list_places
tools.description: List places (sites/buildings) in the organization with address, time zone and lock/member counts. GET /places.

tools.name: kisi_get_place
tools.description: One place by id, including lockdown state. GET /places/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_locks
tools.description: List locks/doors with their state: online, unlocked, locked_down, configured, place and floor. Filter to find offline or locked-down doors. GET /locks.

tools.name: kisi_get_lock
tools.description: One lock/door by id: online/unlocked/locked-down state, place, floor, settings. GET /locks/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_groups
tools.description: List access groups (who-can-open-what bundles of doors). Filter by place or by a lock to see which groups open that door. GET /groups.

tools.name: kisi_get_group
tools.description: One access group by id (name, description, place, member/lock counts, restrictions). GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_group_locks
tools.description: The locks/doors an access group opens. GET /group_locks?group_id=.

tools.name: kisi_list_users
tools.description: List users (members) of the organization. Filter by group or place (users with access there), email, or free text over name/email/notes. Sort by last unlock. GET /users.

tools.name: kisi_get_user
tools.description: One user by id. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_role_assignments
tools.description: Who holds which role where: a user/team/guest's role on the organization, a place or a group (group members = door access). Filter by user, group, place or role. GET /role_assignments.

tools.name: kisi_list_cards
tools.description: List access cards with status (activated/deactivated/unassigned), assignee and last use. GET /cards.

tools.name: kisi_list_presences
tools.description: Who was present at a place on a given day (derived from unlocks): actor, first/last unlock, last door. GET /presences.

tools.name: kisi_list_schedules
tools.description: Time rules: when a group's access is allowed, when doors auto-unlock (unlock timer), first-to-arrive, elevator permit timers. Filter by consequence or by the group/lock it applies to. GET /schedules.

tools.name: kisi_list_controllers
tools.description: Kisi controllers (door hardware hubs) with online/offline status. Filter by place, lock or status. GET /controllers.

tools.name: kisi_list_readers
tools.description: Kisi readers (card/phone readers at doors) with model and online/offline status. GET /readers.

tools.name: kisi_search_events
tools.description: Search the access log (unlocks, denied attempts, lockdowns, admin changes) and return the first page. tools.name: kisi_get_event_set
tools.description: Read an event set from kisi_search_events: its status and events. Pass the previous page's cursor for the next page. GET /event_sets/{id}.

tools.name: kisi_list_event_types
tools.description: All event type names usable as the type filter of kisi_search_events (e.g. lock.unlock). GET /events/types.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kisi_get_current_user, kisi_list_users, kisi_search_events · Private data: kisi_get_current_user · Public sink: kisi_get_current_user, kisi_list_users, kisi_search_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kisi_get_current_user, kisi_list_users, kisi_search_events · Private data: kisi_get_current_user · Public sink: kisi_get_current_user, kisi_list_users, kisi_search_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
